evals.prompt: Implement STIG rule V-220656 (CISC-L2-000100, CAT-II, BPDU Guard) for Cisco IOS. The check content says: 'Review the switch configuration to verify BPDU guard is enabled on all access ports.' The fix text says: 'Configure spanning-tree bpduguard enable on all access switch ports.'
evals.expected_output: Rule metadata added to rules.yaml, evaluation task using evaluate_results filter in cat2.yaml, remediation task gated on stig_results status in cat2.yaml, remediation template with spanning-tree bpduguard enable per port, argument_specs updated.
assertions: Rule metadata exists in roles/evaluate/vars/stig/rules.yaml with V-220656 as key
Evaluation task uses cisco.ios.ios_command to check interface config
Task name follows 'STIG | CISC-L2-000100 | V-220656 | CAT-II | ...' format
Remediation task is conditional on stig_results['V-220656'].status == 'open'
Remediation uses ios_config with save_when: changed
Remediation template contains spanning-tree bpduguard enable
No hardcoded interface names in tasks or templates

evals.prompt: Add STIG rule V-220657 (CISC-L2-000110, CAT-II, STP Loop Guard) for IOS. Check: 'Verify the switch has STP Loop Guard enabled.' Fix: 'Configure spanning-tree loopguard default.' This is a global config, not per-interface.
evals.expected_output: Rule metadata in rules.yaml, evaluation task checking global config, inline remediation (no template needed for global config), argument_specs updated.
assertions: Rule metadata exists in rules.yaml with V-220657 as key
Evaluation task does NOT loop over interfaces (global check)
Remediation uses ios_config with lines, not src/template
Task has correct STIG naming and tags

evals.prompt: I need to add a new STIG rule but I only have the V-key: V-220662. Can you look up the details and implement it?
evals.expected_output: Agent should ask for or look up the STIG ID, severity, CCI, check content, and fix text before implementation. Should not guess metadata.
assertions: Agent requests or gathers the missing STIG metadata before implementing
Agent does not fabricate STIG IDs, CCIs, or check/fix text
If implemented, follows the standard 2-task evaluation pattern
